scope: Gather boundary mechanism observation; no performance acceptance or automatic causal claim
instrumentation: Q4T_LAYER_TIMING=1 plus gather_interval_probe.so only; no PMU or Nsight
validity: Guard COMPLETED and HTTP output/capacity/exit contracts pass
Within client_before/client_after, exactly 25 target copies from one TID, 24*20971520+20943360 bytes
Exactly one target gather row before each matching T>1 layer report; no inferred matching by sorted duration
Per-chunk wait_nr sums and io call counts match across versions; otherwise comparison scope invalid
IO wall <= region wall; CPU clocks nonnegative; IO CPU <= region CPU +10us for endpoint skew
report: Per chunk and sums of region CPU/wall, IO API CPU/wall, remainder wall/CPU, layer-event interval
Each metric paired B-A and same-identity R=max(abs(A2-A1),abs(B2-B1))
Only both positive B-A > R is a resolved positive observable, not causality
Compare whether measured Gather change has same sign and magnitude as event change; do not force attribution or assume all Gather lies on device critical path
limitations: No SSD service time claim; ordinary buffered reads and page cache
Region excludes earlier hash and upload synchronization; remainder includes sorting, scatter, scheduling and observer overhead
First chunk not analyzed; injected logging perturbs execution; TTFT not accepted
Frozen negative result stops this measurement family; no added sampling to force a result
stop_rules: Any guard or HTTP error stops, no automatic retry
No changed thresholds, extra probes or warmups
Keep NO_GO until causal resolution and affected acceptance
